Title: FLOOR 1 // THE SUNKEN CRYPT
Description: An old burial vault beneath the village. Something down there is still gnawing on the bones.
CompletionText: The Warden's keys fall silent. The crypt is quiet at last.

Stages.StoryText: At midnight, the bell rang beneath Hollowmere. By morning, Mara's chair was empty. Her mother remembered having a daughter, but not her name. The elders opened the dungeon gate and begged you to bring back the bell's clapper. From far below, it rang again.
A Giant Cave Rat the size of a hound scrambles out of an open coffin, teeth bared.
A rusted bell tolls somewhere in the dark. A Skeleton Guard rises from its post, keys clattering at its side. One bears a name you recognize from Hollowmere.
At the end of the hall, a great iron door groans open. THE CRYPT WARDEN steps out, a ring of keys clanking at its hip.

Title: FLOOR 2 // THE EMBER CAVERNS
Description: Deep volcanic tunnels where the rock glows red. Something huge is breathing down here.
CompletionText: The drake's fire dies, and her hoard is yours to plunder.

Stages.StoryText: Heat rolls up the tunnel in waves. The walls are streaked with cooling lava, still glowing.
A Stone Sentinel grinds to life, rubble pouring from its shoulders as it turns to face you.
Two burning eyes open in the shadows. A Shadow Wolf has caught your scent.
The cavern opens onto a mountain of gold. Vexara uncoils from her hoard. 'The elders broke the pact,' she growls. 'Now the seal is failing.'

Title: FLOOR 3 // THE LICH'S CATACOMBS
Description: Endless halls of the honoured dead. The dead here are not allowed to rest.
CompletionText: The Lich's bones scatter. The dead of the catacombs can finally rest.

Stages.StoryText: The torches here burn green. The air is cold enough to see your breath.
Drums and shrieking echo up the stairwell. A Goblin Horde pours out of the side passages.
On a throne of bones, Malgrath raises a withered hand. 'The bell takes names so the thing below cannot learn them. Your elders knew the price.'

Title: FLOOR 4 // THE DREAD THRONE
Description: The heart of the dungeon. No hero who has entered this hall has ever walked back out.
CompletionText: The Dread King falls. His black crown rolls to your feet. The realm is free.

Stages.StoryText: Black banners hang from a ceiling you cannot see. Your footsteps echo like a funeral march.
The Dread King lowers his blade. 'I chose who the village forgot. I have hated every toll. I can no longer keep the seal. The choice is yours.'
